## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] Tests cover the change, or this is docs-only.
- [ ] User-visible changes have a fragment in `changes/unreleased/`.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (needs an ADR if you think you need one).
- [ ] No real health data, tokens, or private hostnames in the diff or the description.
